facilities.name: Rastplats Eigdesjön
facilities.description: Official WST rest/picnic point beside the Stage 24 route near Ejgdesjön. No potable water or toilet confirmed at this rest point.

facilities.name: Snarsmon
facilities.description: Cultural/historical site at the former traveller settlement by Ejgdefjäll, explicitly highlighted in the official Stage 24 description. Model as cultural/information point, not a service facility.

facilities.name: Rastplats Ekelidsvattnet / rock shelter
facilities.description: Officially referenced rest point / detour by Ekelidsvattnet, with a rock-shelter/rest context and fireplace/grill context from facility research. It is not directly on the main route line and should be represented as a marked detour/nearby point. Do not snap to the main route. No public potable water confirmed.

facilities.name: Vindskydd Allemarken / Håvedalen shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter/rest facility near Allemarken/Håvedalen, about 1 km before the end according to regional text. Facility research found shelter, dry-toilet, fireplace/firewood, waste and tent-place context nearby. This is the key overnight/rest facility for Stage 24. No public potable water confirmed. Cluster nearby OSM shelter/fire/toilet/waste/tent records to avoid duplicate POIs.
